result.summary: Lantern Utilities (Mercer) emailed "Attached invoice" (event 041), but no attachment is visible on the ticket, so I can't check it against the landlord's approval of £90 + VAT. I've asked the contractor to resend the invoice as a PDF and confirm the hinge was replaced at the 30/09 visit. The ticket has moved to works and is on hold with a 3-day follow-up. Once the invoice arrives and matches, it goes to the landlord and the ticket moves to close-out.

judgement.why_this_decision: The landlord first agreed to a contractor visit (event 007), then approved the hinge replacement at £90 + VAT (events 016/018). The visit was booked for 30/09/2025 (events 027-031). There were no work results afterwards (event 036), so the agency chased for completion and a PDF invoice (event 038). The contractor replied 'Attached invoice' (event 041), but the CRM lists no attachments. Lesson #3 says to forward the invoice to the landlord and move to close-out, and lesson #18 says the invoice note can count as proof of completion. I can't follow either yet because there is no invoice to check for amount, payee or property, and nothing that confirms completion. The contractor is the one who can fix this, so I asked them rather than escalating.

alternatives_considered.option: Forward the invoice to the landlord and move to close-out (lesson #3)
alternatives_considered.why_not: No invoice is visible, so I can't check it against the approved £90 + VAT or send it on.
A missing attachment is something the contractor can fix by resending. There's no conflict or dispute yet.

alternatives_considered.option: No action / return to auto mode
alternatives_considered.why_not: The invoice is missing and completion isn't confirmed, so the job would stall without a follow-up.

assumptions: 'Jenkins' and 'Mercer' are both staff at Lantern Utilities
'Felix', who signed the landlord replies, is the landlord on record (Grace) or acts for them
